variants.rot_report: one Haar unitary per report, shared by all tone groups
variants.rot_group: one fresh Haar unitary per report and per tone group

variants.rot_group_cb42: per-group rotation, all reports re-quantised at 4-bit phi / 2-bit psi
variants.rot_group_cb64: per-group rotation, all reports re-quantised at 6-bit phi / 4-bit psi
variants.rot_group_cb42_n234: per-group rotation, 4/2 bits and the first 234 tone groups of every report

null_noise.note:
The protocol on pure noise: the same windows, sessions, galleries
    and seeds, every feature vector i.i.d. standard normal. What it scores
    above chance is the decision rule's own bias (1-NN with K = all favours
    the device with the most enrolled windows), not a leak.
